label: STAGING-AUTH-SESSION-203
rootCause: Staging database had migration 0108_secure_session_enhancements pending (106 applied). Auth code from 4410a02 writes sessions.last_activity_at, is_trusted_device, and revoked_reason. Missing columns caused POST /auth/refresh and POST /auth/login (session create) to throw Postgres errors surfaced as HTTP 500 INTERNAL_ERROR / "An unexpected error occurred" — blocking re-login after cookie restore failure.

code: apps/web/src/lib/api-client.ts — classify 5xx refresh as unreachable (not false session_expired banner)
apps/api/src/routes/auth.ts — clear stale refresh cookie before issuing new session on login; broaden DB schema error detection in handleAuthError

signupAndRefresh.detail: 201 signup + Set-Cookie Path=/api/v1/auth Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Lax; refresh rotation 200

deploy.note: DB migration 0108 applied live before code deploy; both services healthy
